I woke up late and the rain kept falling
We were running out of time again
You said you'd call me back but I'm still waiting
I figured out that you were never coming
So I packed my bags and walked away
The streetlights flicker while I wander home
I'm done with chasing shadows in the dark
Maybe I was wrong to let you go
Tomorrow I will not look back at all
The morning light is breaking through the clouds
